ev.q: Patients ranged in age from 19–47 years and included seven students, one faculty member, and one staff member.
Sixty-three cases were reported to CDC, including 15 among adults.
Testing by MDH using RT-PCR identified Enterovirus in four of five throat swab specimens and in the swab from the lesion
Throat swabs were obtained from five patients, and an open lesion was swabbed from a sixth.
In September 2014, MDH received reports of nine suspected HFMD cases at a college with approximately 1,000 students.
